record.title: Test one existing application-data type on the two calibration fixture files
record.intent: Resolve the observed file-label failure without changing the guest policy or stock bytes.
requirements: Pin the preceding EACCES observation and static type review; distinguish matching-source permissions and compiled symbol presence from unconfirmed compiled allow rules or constraints.

Freeze one new fixture profile using the same byte-identical private probe APK stock assets and derived ramdisk; preserve the original su_tmpfs evidence and apply system_app_data_file:s0 only to the two explicit default file paths after the unchanged filesystem preconditions pass.

Perform no recursive labeling directory label change permission relaxation policy modification or alternate retry. Capture both command results and pre/post labels metadata complete bytes and the fixed absent paths; stop on a failed label precondition or assignment.

Run the same private UID1000 system_app probe once and verify each metadata open and complete bounded read outcome independently; support an honest negative outcome and test verification against altered evidence with regenerated indexes.

Remove the private package and capture final system_server enforcement process package filesystem and teardown evidence even on failure; preserve stock artifacts and commit and push the conclusion before another guest experiment.
acceptance: Commit and push a precise result for the two-file label hypothesis.
